    """Detect glass transition temperature using two-line fit method."""
    
    # Sort by temperature (should already be sorted in cooling)
    sort_idx = np.argsort(temperatures)
    temps = temperatures[sort_idx]
    dens = densities[sort_idx]
    
    # Remove duplicates and average densities at same temperature
    unique_temps = []
    unique_dens = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(temps):
        temp = temps[i]
        temp_dens = [dens[i]]
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(temps) and abs(temps[j] - temp) < 1e-6:
            temp_dens.append(dens[j])
            j += 1
        unique_temps.append(temp)
        unique_dens.append(np.mean(temp_dens))
        i = j
    
    temps = np.array(unique_temps)
    dens = np.array(unique_dens)
    
    # Try different split points to find best two-line fit
    best_tg = None
    best_r2 = -np.inf
    
    # Only consider middle 60% of temperature range for potential Tg
    n = len(temps)
    start_idx = int(0.2 * n)
    end_idx = int(0.8 * n)
    
    for split_idx in range(start_idx, end_idx):
        # Fit two lines
        # High temperature (liquid) region
        high_temps = temps[split_idx:]
        high_dens = dens[split_idx:]

        low_dens = dens[:split_idx]

        # Linear fits
        slope_high, intercept_high, r_high, _, _ = stats.linregress(high_temps, high_dens)
        slope_low, intercept_low, r_low, _, _ = stats.linregress(low_temps, low_dens)
        
        # Calculate combined R^2
        pred_high = slope_high * high_temps + intercept_high
        pred_low = slope_low * low_temps + intercept_low
        
        ss_res = np.sum((high_dens - pred_high)**2) + np.sum((low_dens - pred_low)**2)

        r2_combined = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
